Resolves #21879
Related: #21358, #21140, #21142, #21856, neomjs/pages#194

Rebuilds `examples/stateProvider/advanced` in place as **One state, every surface** (`state-provider` in `apps/portal/resources/data/examples/state.json`, `alsoIn: ["multi-window"]`): one `Neo.state.Provider` on `MainContainer` owns a `members` store of `Neo.data.Record` instances and binds the active record across the live hero header, team roster (`MemberList`), four-field profile form (`ProfileFields`), non-modal floating `ProfileDialog`, and SharedWorker `CompanionSurface` popup window, while a nested `StateProvider` on the preview card overrides `density` locally (`Compact` vs root `Comfortable`). Companion dark and light covers (`devmode/state-provider-14.jpg`, `devmode/state-provider-14-light.jpg`) merged in [neomjs/pages#194](https://github.com/neomjs/pages/pull/194) and verified live (`HTTP 200`).

Evidence: L5 (`neomjs/pages#194` merged & verified HTTP 200 on `raw.githubusercontent.com`, `buildScripts/docs/captureExamples.mjs --record state-provider`, unit + SharedWorker multi-window Playwright E2E, and `1440 × 900` / `390 × 844` / Portal catalog renders in Neo Dark & Neo Light) → L5 required (AC-5 served Pages covers + deployed Portal verification). Residual: Post-Merge Validation, Residual-Owner: #21358.

agent-preflight: not hosted here; baseline PR baseline, Commit authorship ran.

## Deltas from ticket

- **Non-modal docked `ProfileDialog` (`modal: false, trapFocus: false`):** Positioned bottom-right in CSS (`.sp-profile-dialog.neo-dialog.neo-floating`) with zero inline `wrapperStyle`, letting visitors type directly in the page form while the dialog stays open (`AC-1`) without obscuring the header or nested override card (`AC-6`).
- **Companion focus & reload ownership (`3edf4e7c22`):** Repeat `Focus second window` routes through `Neo.Main.windowFocus` without re-staging the popup document, and companion reloads verify `window.opener` + `Neo.Main.openWindows[windowName].targetName` ownership so two primary tabs never cross-bind and unowned `?companion=1` tabs render `disconnectedState` with disabled inputs.
- **Out-of-scope substrate findings noted via `defect-note:`:** (1) `src/state/createHierarchicalDataProxy.mjs:62` skips `Neo.data.Record` in its `get` trap so bindings use `data['member.<field>']` (`MESSAGE:f530fa8c`); (2) `test/playwright/dedicatedWorkerNeuralLink.mjs:710` leaves dedicated `appWorker` cached across navigation to a `SharedWorker` page, avoided by splitting `StandaloneThemeSwitcher.spec.mjs`'s combined test (`MESSAGE:8242ac16`); (3) `resources/css/src/form/field/Text.css:394` `.label-top` omits `height: auto`, scoped locally in `examples/stateProvider/advanced/MainContainer.css` (`MESSAGE:e141f01a`).
- **E2E selection & shard duration:** Registered `core/StateProviderSurfacesNL.spec.mjs` in `test/playwright/externalBrainSelection.mjs` (`ADAPTER_ELIGIBLE_SPECS`) and `buildScripts/util/e2eEngineDurations.json` (`4.4s`).

Frame critique: three defects fixed across `742a670aec`, `19af057a68`, and `3edf4e7c22` — overriding `.neo-textfield.label-top`'s inherited `27px` inline height eliminated stacked label/input clipping, shrinking nested ledger labels kept `Override panel to Comfortable` inside the `960 × 540` cover viewport, trimming `state.json`'s `feature` string from `130` to `97` characters in `19af057a68` resolved the mid-sentence two-line clamp on the `State & Data` and `Multi-Window` cards, and binding `.sp-try-line` to `canOpenPopup` in `3edf4e7c22` omits the second-window clause at `390 × 844` while keeping the `960 × 540` / `1440 × 900` desktop frame byte-identical to `neomjs/pages#194`. Remaining trade-offs kept intentionally: (1) in `1440 × 900` Neo Dark (`ex-2.png`), `.sp-shell.neo-container` inherits `theme-neo-dark`'s `#0b0e17` container fill down to `y ≈ 535` above `.sp-advanced-viewport`'s `#0e141d` canvas; (2) in the three-column member roster, secondary role/location subtitles ellipsis-truncate (`Principal Product Designe…`) while the selected member's full metadata shows in both the hero header and nested preview card; (3) at thumbnail scale in `Multi-Window`, the landing cover shows the form, nested card, and `Open second window` CTA rather than a pre-opened popup (popups require a user gesture), while `after-all-surfaces-dark.png` above shows all four live surfaces open together.
